text:
alex: Heads-up — planning a rollforward of runtime v2.3.1 to the staged canary at 15:00 PT. Preflight smoke looked ok but p95 for small-seq jumped ~12% on a handful of hosts. Requesting quick perf signoff + any profiling help.

maria: Can you paste the perf diffs and the profiling links?

alex: Perf diffs: https://internal.redwood/perf/diff/2366 — summary shows p50 ~0, p95 +12% on small-seq, large-seq unchanged. Command I ran:
```
./bench.sh --model=redwood-v2-small --seq=32 --runs=100 --tag=preflight-2366
```
KV cache enabled in those runs.

deploy-bot: Automated smoke: all health checks passed. deploy/2366 staged -> 8/10 hosts healthy, 2 hosts flapped during start but recovered (no traces on error queue).

devon: Noted. I saw increased kernel pagefaults on the rtx-pool during similar runs last week. Starting a heap/profile capture on the two flapping hosts now. Will post flamegraphs shortly.

liam: If this is isolated to small-seq the fastpath/batching heuristics could be the culprit. Could we repro with --batch=1 and --no-prefetch to see if batching/aggregation triggers it?

alex: Good call. Kicking off targeted runs with `--batch=1` and `--no-kvcache` on the effected canary hosts. Also pinging eng-sre to keep an eye on eviction metrics.

maria: Quick vote: rollforward/hold/rollback? Please react with :thumbsup: rollforward, :thumbsdown: rollback, :hand: hold, or reply.

ashley: :thumbsup: rollforward — impact seems contained, but I'll stay on monitoring for 30m.

maria: :hand: hold — prefer to wait for devon's profiles and a no-kvcache run before final.

devon: Uploaded flamegraphs & perf profiles: https://internal.redwood/profiles/2366-flame.
Looks like a hotspot in the attention kernel allocation path when seq<=48. Will run a bisect on the kernel change set.

alex: Summary: mixed signals — infra smoke ok, perf increase on p95 small-seq, profiling points to attention alloc path. Decision needed.

liam: My preference is hold and roll back if we can't produce a clean `--no-kvcache` run within 20m. The KV cache path changes were in the same PR as the kernel tweak.

alex: OK — consensus leaning hold. I'm pausing the staged rollout and initiating a rollback on the 8 staged hosts now to be safe. I'll post rollback status.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for deploy/2366 at 2026-03-17T22:05:12Z. Target hosts: 8. Rolling back in batches of 2.

deploy-bot: rollback complete for deploy/2366 at 2026-03-17T22:12:43Z. All hosts back to v2.3.0. Incident alert suppressed.

ashley: Thanks — I'll open a small PR to revert the batching heuristic in the short term and add a test for small-seq p95.

alex: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: devon to bisect kernel/kalloc changes, ashley to open revert PR, liam to run KV-cache-disabled perf matrix, maria to coordinate a re-run after fixes. I'll write a short postmortem and tag eng-runtime. Closing this thread once the re-run is scheduled.

maria: Adding a calendar slot for a quick sync at 10am PT tomorrow to review re-run results.

alex: Perfect. Closing for now. If anyone sees any regressions in other customers, ping me directly.
